source_holds.description: Original RFC5424 SYSLOG, NIST SP800-57/SP800-53/FIPS140-2, JTNC RSS, DS-101/EKMS, KMI/OTNK, RSS API, NVMe/DARE detailed originals not audited. C239 clauses are read, not companion requirements/schemas certified.
Required key-tag format refers to an explicit TBD; no tag syntax or cardinality invented.
Source describes future Data-in-Transit Encryption Rules as Section12.3.2, but that section actually defines DARE; preserve discrepancy, do not infer DiTE rules.
UTC vs uptime conditional audit event rule, optional secure channel and trust-grade caution; no authenticated global clock or source event time inferred from uptime.
Printed star on Zeroize/GetKey/etc denotes adopted JTNC RSS origin, not optional interaction or established native schema. Preserve semantics and source origin.
CSP zeroization Security Services scoped; not full-media sanitization, all-PIC wiping or proven hardware operation. Source warns of storage/mission-dependent assurance.
Normative classified cryptomaterial modules are required to be appropriately certified; this does not prove any named studied device, cert issuer or deployment has such certification.
Authorization service grant/deny and module's check before privileged act do not establish caller identity, actual grant, execution or effect. Cache only permitted while previous authorization valid.

Table has 43 accepted primarily RF host interaction names; UCI/VICTORY/STANAG4586/OMS original companions not audited. Figure12.10.2-1 cites Table15.6.2-1 instead of relevant 12.10.2-1. Host tasking vs SystemManager vs TaskManager roles distinct.

Seven modules explicitly not defined in Edition1.1. Functional SvcV tables are reference-only, including Power, Nav Data, Time & Frequency, Calibration and Network; no universal required hardware elements or effective telemetry.

Host Power, Power, Power Assignment and Power Assignment Response are distinct I/O and role descriptions; do not fabricate source type, battery chemistry, present charge, health, or physical supply chain.
Indexed original PDF inline labels/table text inspected; original pixels/arrow geometries and external native DIV-2/3 schemas and all eight C239 DSDM/IDL/OpenAPI companions not fully reviewed.
